tools.name: search
tools.description: Search premium aftermarket domain names for sale on HugeDomains.com by keyword. Returns results with an id (the domain name), a title including the USD price, and the purchase URL. Pass an id to fetch for full details. Equivalent to search_aftermarket_domains_for_sale without filters.

tools.name: get_aftermarket_domain_listing
tools.description: Get the buy-it-now listing for one specific domain name for sale on HugeDomains.com: USD price, TLD, length, tags, the purchaseUrl where a person buys it, and estimated monthly payment plan terms when offered. tools.name: search_aftermarket_domains_for_sale
tools.description: Search the HugeDomains.com catalog of premium aftermarket domain names for sale by keyword, with optional TLD, USD price range and name-length filters. tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full listing for one domain for sale on HugeDomains.com by id (the domain name, as returned by search). Returns the USD price, purchase URL and payment plan estimate as text plus structured metadata. Equivalent to get_aftermarket_domain_listing.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
